artifacts.title: AUDITS Protocol Documentation
artifacts.summary: The AUDITS protocol is a decentralized auditing protocol that enables secure and transparent auditing of smart contracts.

artifacts.title: AUDITS Protocol Audit Reports
artifacts.summary: The AUDITS protocol has undergone several audits, which have identified and addressed potential security vulnerabilities.

artifacts.title: AUDITS Protocol Governance
artifacts.summary: The AUDITS protocol is governed by a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO), which ensures that the protocol is developed and maintained in a transparent and community-driven manner.

artifacts.title: AUDITS Protocol Deployment
artifacts.summary: The AUDITS protocol has been deployed on several blockchain networks, including Ethereum and Binance Smart Chain.
